evidence.appropriate: the keystone holding the arch is the one idea, drawn; it reads without a caption; sturdy and grounded (Everyman), enclosing (Caregiver)
evidence.distinctive: none of the five (FreshBooks, Wave, Bonsai, HoneyBook, Chaser) uses architecture or stone; heavy band, square feet and a raised flat-topped keystone; no tile, no slant
evidence.simple: one arch and one stone, 19 anchors; drawable from memory in three strokes
evidence.legible: the 16 px favicon holds as an arch with a raised crown; the joints read from 48 px and close (by design) in the favicon tier; wordmark x-height 9.7 px at 120 px
evidence.adaptable: black on white and white on black both hold; the app icon is the arch alone; motion: the keystone drops into the crown and locks; embroidery uses the jointless favicon silhouette
evidence.timeless: no trend shape from trends.md; an arch and its keystone read the same a century ago
evidence.universal: mirrored panel identical; rotated 90 reads as a D with a megaphone (an orientation nobody sees); upright there is a faint horseshoe-magnet reading
evidence.clear: description searches ('arch with raised keystone logo', 'keystone arch logo') found stock 'Keystone' arch logos (Dreamstime 336333639, Adobe Stock 2199319247): the same idea in other hands, no registered conflict seen; full knock-out in refinement
evidence.congruent: shape 0.4: round crown on straight feet; symmetric; low complexity; heavy; framed (the arch encloses its opening); static; the heavy, round-shouldered form suits KEE-stone's stops and long o
evidence.system: horizontal, stacked, symbol, compact, small and favicon all build with no tier warnings; the favicon merges the three stones; rationale draft in critique.md
